mapper.select: SELECT * FROM reconciliation_checkpoint WHERE scan_type = #{scanType} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO reconciliation_checkpoint (scan_type, last_scanned_id, updated_at) VALUES (#{scanType}, #{lastScannedId}, #{updatedAt}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE last_scanned_id = VALUES(last_scanned_id), updated_at = VALUES(updated_at)
mapper.update: UPDATE reconciliation_checkpoint SET last_scanned_id = #{lastScannedId}, updated_at = NOW(3) WHERE scan_type = #{scanType}
